title: Caseoh Is Insanely Bad At Crafting In Minecraft 💀😭
author: ibohclips

audit.framing_9x16: Classic 50/50 vertical stack: Top half dedicated to streamer facecam with dark blurred background letterboxing; bottom half focused directly on the gameplay HUD, crafting grid, furnace, and inventory.
audit.subtitle_craft: Centered on the dividing line between facecam and game. Features a dual approach: single-to-two word punchy spoken dialogue captions in heavy white sans-serif with thick black outline, combined with bracketed action callouts (*CRAFTS*, *SEARCHES*, *FINDS*, *EMBARRASSED*, *PANICKS*) that guide the viewer through silent gameplay sequences without lagging or lingering.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Dynamic punch-ins targeting specific comedic points: snaps from 1.0x to 1.35x directly onto the 3x3 crafting grid during recipe confusion, instant snap to full-screen facecam when CaseOh screams or facepalms, and tight cropping into the furnace/inventory output to build anticipation.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Playful, lighthearted rhythmic background music underscoring the montage, punctuated by crisp wooden Minecraft block placement and crafting SFX. Comedic stingers, pop-in swooshes for PNG armor overlays, and sudden unmuted mic clipping on CaseOh's screaming triumphs create sharp dynamic contrast.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Aggressive jump-cutting trims all dead space between recipe attempts, turning a 10-minute struggle into a rapid-fire sequence of trial, error, and embarrassment. Pacing accelerates into frantic edits during the netherite craft, pauses briefly on CaseOh's blank realization, then culminates in the triumphant enchanting setup payoff.
standout_techniques: Contextual action tags (*CRAFTS*, *PANICKS*) to maintain narrative pacing during wordless gameplay actions
Semi-transparent meme reaction overlay (faded despondent face over crafting grid) visualising mental collapse
Animated floating PNG inventory items (armor, sword, pickaxe) sliding onto screen to illustrate his running internal monologue
Top-of-head thought bubble graphic (SpongeBob meme) synced to prolonged silence and confusion
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Slight typo in on-screen captions ('*EMBARASSED*' instead of 'EMBARRASSED')
Placing action captions directly over the crafting cursor, occasionally obscuring fine mouse movements
